theorem_statement: The exact sequence with kernel the native V4 and quotient S5 splits. A subgroup of order 120 maps isomorphically onto the five-matching S5 action and intersects the native V4 only in the identity. Conjugation on the native V4 factors through the sign of S5: every element fixes a, even elements fix b and ab separately, and odd elements exchange b with ab.
group_structure: V4 semidirect S5, with S5 acting through sign by a -> a and b <-> ab

interpretation.earned: The hidden four-state register and the visible five-point symmetric action can be separated as a split finite group extension.
interpretation.important_nonclaim: A split extension does not make the native V4 central. Only a is fixed centrally; odd visible permutations exchange the b and ab characters.
